product_overview: A role-based authentication application that lets users sign in with email and password and be routed to the correct dashboard based on their role. It also includes account registration and password reset entry points.
core_goals: Create a new user account with name, email, and password
Sign in with valid credentials and reach the correct dashboard
Prevent access to protected areas without authentication
Support password reset initiation through email
Allow authenticated users to sign out of the application

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Let new users create an account by providing their name, email, and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Confirm the password -> Submit the registration form -> See the account created and return to the main page
Navigate to /register -> Leave one or more required fields empty or provide invalid values -> Submit the registration form -> See validation messages

features.name: User Login
features.description: Let users authenticate with email and password and be sent to the dashboard for their role.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the admin dashboard when using admin credentials
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit the login form -> See the user dashboard when using user credentials
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in an incorrect password -> Submit the login form -> See an error message and remain on the login page
Navigate to /login -> Leave the email field empty or leave the password field empty -> Submit the login form -> See validation messages

features.name: User Logout
features.description: Let signed-in users end their session and return to the public landing page.
user_flows: From an authenticated session, sign out -> See the welcome page

features.name: Lupa Password
features.description: Let users start a password reset by requesting an OTP and then setting a new password.
user_flows: Navigate to /lupa-password -> Fill in email -> Request the OTP -> Enter the OTP code -> Set a new password -> Complete the password reset process
